data.name: Account.Erase.Explanation
data.value: Erasing removes your name, your email address and your password for good, and signs you out of every device. It cannot be undone. We keep only records that no longer identify you and the proof that you accepted the terms, which the law requires us to keep. The email address becomes free again for a new account.
